पैप्पल पैप्पल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. पिप्पल),
made of the wood of the holy fig-tree.

पैप्पलाद, अस्, ई, अम्, derived from Pippalāda;
(आस्), m. pl., N. of a school.

पैप्पलादक, अस्, ई, अम्, peculiar to or taught
by Pippalāda or Paippalāda; (अम्), n. the treatise or
text of Pippalāda.

पैप्पलादि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Pippa-
lāda; N. of a teacher.
